value.title: I Fell in Love, and That's Why I Decided to Escape
value.synopsis: Yoshitake Shiraishi recalls his days in the Kabato Prison before the Russo-Japanese War. There, he encounters an imprisoned master forger, Chouan Kumagishi, who gives him a drawing of Sister Miyazawa, a woman well-known for visiting prisons across the country. Shiraishi's obsession with meeting the nun leads to a series of events that earn him the nickname Escape King.

value.title: Monster
value.synopsis: An Ainu sealskin garment that once belonged to Asirpa's great aunt ends up in the possession of Eddie Dun, an American artifact collector. To recover the garment, Asirpa, Saichi Sugimoto, Shiraishi, and Kiroranke must kill the monster that is attacking Eddie's horses. While Asirpa, Sugimoto, and one of Eddie's men learn the truth about the monster, Shiraishi and Kiroranke run into a mysterious duo connected to a crime that took place at the Naganuma Racetrack.

value.title: Shiton’s Animal Chronicles
value.synopsis: When an Ainu village discovers that someone has been defiling their livestock and then butchering them, the blame falls on Genjirou Tanigaki. Luckily, Shiraishi remembers Shiton Anehata, a tattooed convict who was imprisoned for similar crimes. While the Ainu prepare to punish Tanigaki, Asirpa and Sugimoto pursue Shiton to capture him in order to clear Tanigaki's name before it is too late.
